comparator.name: Psychology (English)
comparator.sourceNotes: The normal English Psychology track totals sixty EC per year. Clinical Psychology is retained using the first-listed major on the primary programme page as the neutral tie-break. Its three named six-credit courses and six-credit assessment course are instantiated. The thirty-credit choice window is open, with at least twelve credits related to psychology. GROW carries no credit.
components: Introduction to Psychology and History of Psychology

Academic Skills C includes information-literacy and plagiarism tests and 20 experimental-subject participation hours. All first-year work, including those hours, must be completed before thesis entry. GROW guidance carries no credit.

The Clinical Psychology major contains Emotions: Scientific and Clinical Aspects, Personality Disorders, Introduction to Treatment Methods and Psychological Assessment, each worth 6 EC. Practical-exercise participation is required where specified.
Mobility Window: exchange, Psychology minor and electives

The 30 EC open space can contain approved minor or elective study, including study abroad. At least 12 EC must be psychology-related, and elective choices require prior Examination Board approval. No particular elective is assumed.

Thesis entry requires all first-year courses and at least 60 EC from later years. The February group is advised to have 138 EC. A quantitative thesis is illustrated; qualitative or systematic-review theses require the corresponding 3 EC elective before submission.

routeSelection.basis: The generic English Psychology target offers nine equally formal majors and does not identify one as the broad default. Clinical Psychology is listed first on the official current programme page, so it is selected as the neutral official-order tie-break before and independently of UCR course selection.

courses: New Issues in Contemporary Social Theory

core: Human thought, emotion, behaviour, personality, development and social influence
Clinical mental health, psychopathology, health, stress, assessment and treatment
Brain, cognition, biological psychology and neuropsychology
Psychological research, statistics, test theory, data science and professional ethics
adjacent: Clinical, medical, health and lifespan psychology
Social, forensic, economic, work and organisational applications of psychology
Quantitative, qualitative and evidence-based psychological research
questions: How do biological, cognitive, social and developmental processes shape behaviour?
How are psychological problems, stress and illness assessed, explained and treated?
How can psychological claims and interventions be tested with sound evidence and data?

alternatives.label: Broad psychology, behaviour & research
alternatives.labelReason: Study behaviour and mental processes through social, developmental, clinical and cognitive psychology, research methods, philosophy and social context. Organisational psychology adds personality, motivation and group processes.
alternatives.concept: Study behaviour and mental processes through social, developmental, clinical and cognitive psychology, research methods, philosophy and social context. Organisational psychology adds personality, motivation and group processes.
progression: Verified current offerings and every earlier formal prerequisite. Research methods precedes behavioural statistics, psychopathology precedes assessment, and data science precedes machine learning and image processing. Psycholinguistics follows the brain gateway in its only planned 2027h1 offering; no additional prerequisite is invented.

alternatives.label: Clinical, health & lifespan psychology
alternatives.labelReason: Study mental health and development across the lifespan through psychopathology, introductory assessment and psychotherapy, health psychology, neuroscience, emotion and ethics. Epidemiology and selected biological treatment foundations complement this psychological core.
alternatives.concept: Study mental health and development across the lifespan through psychopathology, introductory assessment and psychotherapy, health psychology, neuroscience, emotion and ethics. Epidemiology and selected biological treatment foundations complement this psychological core.
progression: Verified current offerings and every earlier formal prerequisite. Research methods precedes behavioural statistics, psychopathology precedes assessment, and data science precedes machine learning and image processing. Psycholinguistics follows the brain gateway in its only planned 2027h1 offering; no additional prerequisite is invented.
alternatives.distinctness: This option adds epidemiology, physiology, pharmacology and ethics while placing less weight on rhetoric, general social theory and philosophical agency. These courses support health, stress and treatment questions; disease pathology is removed.

alternatives.label: Brain, cognition & behavioural science
alternatives.labelReason: Study brain, cognition and behaviour through neuroscience, perception, language and higher cognitive functions. Combine psychological research and clinical foundations with data analysis, machine learning, image processing and critical inquiry into AI and human agency.
alternatives.concept: Study brain, cognition and behaviour through neuroscience, perception, language and higher cognitive functions. Combine psychological research and clinical foundations with data analysis, machine learning, image processing and critical inquiry into AI and human agency.
progression: Verified current offerings and every earlier formal prerequisite. Research methods precedes behavioural statistics, psychopathology precedes assessment, and data science precedes machine learning and image processing. Psycholinguistics follows the brain gateway in its only planned 2027h1 offering; no additional prerequisite is invented.
alternatives.distinctness: This option develops a computational and cognitive emphasis through data science, machine learning, image processing, AI ethics and agency. It retains psychological and clinical foundations. Molecular pathology and generic laboratory training are removed rather than treated as cognitive science.

blocks: Both develop empirical research design, measurement, sampling and evaluation of evidence. UCR also includes statistics and a research project.
Both examine ethical reasoning and competing moral responsibilities. Tilburg applies these directly to professional psychological practice; UCR studies broader ethical theories.
Both critically examine mind, consciousness, self and accounts of mental states.
Both examine theories of emotion and its relationships with cognition, action and social life. Tilburg also includes clinical emotion regulation and treatment applications.
Both introduce sociological theories, institutions, social relationships and inequality.
Both examine biological and neural mechanisms underlying psychological processes.
Both study perception and action as psychological processes using their scientific foundations. UCR emphasises neural mechanisms and neuropsychological interpretation.
Both connect brain structure and neural processes with psychological functions and behaviour.
Both study social cognition, influence, groups and interpersonal behaviour through psychological research.
Both develop regression modelling, statistical assumptions and interpretation of behavioural evidence. UCR also develops experimental-design and other statistical methods.
Both examine classification, explanations and treatment of mental disorders.

Both develop diagnostic reasoning, interviews, test administration and interpretation, ethics and case integration. UCR combines introductory assessment with psychotherapy rather than offering the complete specialist assessment course.
Both examine physical, cognitive, emotional and social development across life stages and its theoretical explanations.

notes.text: Tilburg combines broad psychology with a named major, professional skills, advanced methods and a required thesis. The UCR options combine psychological and cognitive study with complementary social, philosophical, health or data methods. They do not reproduce the complete specialist major or establish a clinical professional qualification.

selection.assessment: Broad psychology supplies a defensible closest response. Health/clinical development and brain/cognitive/data inquiry are separately evidenced priorities with substantive curricular consequences. Each pair exceeds the thirty-credit floor; three is the maximum.

audience.programmeDescription: Psychology at Tilburg University studies mind and behaviour through broad psychological foundations, research and professional skills, followed by a major and thesis. This example uses the English-taught Clinical Psychology major.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers broad psychological study and related priorities in clinical health and lifespan development or brain, cognition and data methods. Tilburg provides a more specialised psychology major and professional sequence. The comparison describes academic relationships and does not establish clinical registration or postgraduate admission.
